source_caption:
🎬 Bruce Almighty (2003)

Bruce Almighty follows Bruce Nolan, a frustrated television reporter living in Buffalo, New York, who believes that nothing in his life ever goes his way. After losing an important career opportunity and blaming God for his problems, Bruce unexpectedly meets God himself, who offers him divine powers to see whether he can do a better job running the world. Suddenly able to perform miracles, control reality, and make his wildest wishes come true, Bruce begins using his extraordinary abilities to improve his own life. However, as his selfish decisions create unexpected consequences, he discovers that having unlimited power doesn’t necessarily bring happiness. Starring Jim Carrey, Morgan Freeman, and Jennifer Aniston, the film combines hilarious comedy, heartfelt moments, and meaningful lessons about love, responsibility, gratitude, and appreciating what truly matters.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Fantasy • Romance • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 6.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 41m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Tom Shadyac

✍️ Writers: Steve Koren, Mark O’Keefe & Steve Oedekerk

📺 Where to Watch: Check Peacock, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current streaming or rental availability in the United States.
